answers.text: "A shallow reaction is not a base with a pivot." A base is not my test; C5 is trend, normal reaction, then new high. W above EMA9 9>21 (trend), D dist_to_20bar_high_pct 4.6 with H1 below EMA9 9<21 (reaction unfinished). I never claimed a breakout day; my buy is the new high still to print. close_vs_swing_high_pct 9.86 is vs an October pivot, not a chase of the 20-day high.

"elder_5d stepped down from 10 to 7, not accelerating." That reading is advisory to my method, never my test. My trend-state analogue is mp_state STRONG with mp_accel_state ACCELERATING (C18). On the grid: W HH/HL, D HH/HL with close_vs_swing_high_pct -0.51, H1 above EMA9 9>21 at pos_in_day_range_pct 73.1. Trend and proximity to the new high stand.
